preconditions.description: The input string S must have at least one character.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(min(len(S), len(S[i:])) - min(len(S), len(S[i:])) + len(S) - i for i in range(len(S)))
postconditions.description: The function returns the sum of the similarities between the string S and each of its suffixes, where similarity is defined as the length of the longest common prefix between S and its suffix S[i:].

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= similarity <= len(S) for similarity in [min(len(S), len(S[i:])) - min(len(S), len(S[i:])) + len(S) - i for i in range(len(S))])
postconditions.description: Each individual similarity value between S and its suffixes must be a non-negative integer not exceeding the length of S.
